mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and the CPI index (indicating inflationary pressure) signals a tightening cycle that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in the end of the cycle.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.5% in last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong economic growth (quarterly GDP growth > 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in continued expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with improving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and higher corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates sustained economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rise > 0.5% and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of expanding manufacturing output (INDPRO growth > 0.5% in the last month), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in improving industrial conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.5%.
